options.text: The amount of carbon in fossil fuels underground
The total greenhouse gas emissions caused by an activity, measured in CO2 equivalent
The amount of carbon dioxide absorbed by trees
The size of a person's shoe print in carbon-rich soil

questions.explanation: A carbon footprint is the total amount of greenhouse gases produced by an individual, event, product, or organisation, measured in tonnes of CO2 equivalent (CO2e). It includes all greenhouse gases (not just CO2), converted to CO2 equivalent for comparison.

questions.stem: Which action would have the greatest impact in reducing a household's carbon footprint?

options.text: Switching from plastic to paper bags
Installing home insulation and using renewable energy
Using a different brand of washing powder
Buying bottled water instead of tap water

questions.explanation: Installing insulation reduces heat loss, meaning less energy is needed for heating (saving 1-2 tonnes CO2/year). Switching to renewable energy eliminates CO2 from electricity generation. These are among the highest-impact actions. Home energy typically accounts for 20-30% of a household's carbon footprint.
